compatibility: Canonical Mage effect keys, rolls, enhancement rules, item/prefix IDs and archived reward catalogs unchanged. Global attack-speed equipment stat preserved. Runtime route selected from saved item identity.

vfx.widthGrowth: Witch orb diameter 28 to 37.8; drain ground diameter 190 to 256.5; Warrior slash width 140 to 189; sword wave width 128 to 172.8
vfx.noWidthGrowth: Shield Rush level increases time/distance, not body or barrier width. Archer skill level/weapon damage does not increase arrow/rain/trap radius. Leap weapon increases start-stop span only.
vfx.mage: Existing projectile head radius scaling retained. Fireball impact fixed 180px source envelope mapped to actual AoE diameter; unchanged missile hit spark and lightning/shield rendering.

tests.browser: 4 classes x levels 1 and 8; local/remote pixels identical; real source-stat boss summon; real bridge tap-chain effect; v148 regression browser scripts

limitations: Pixel equality is deterministic local testing of the remote renderer; online deployment validation separately checks actual hosted code hashes. No synthetic tests write remote player accounts.
